name: Daily Taiwan Eligible Async Remote Job Hunter

parameters.jsCode:
return $input.all().map(item=>({
  ...item,
  json:{
    ...item.json,
    cover_letter_prompt:`Write a short cover letter for Jerry applying to the role of ${item.json.job_title||'this position'} at ${item.json.company||'this company'}.

About Jerry:
- Based in Taiwan, available for fully remote global work
- Bilingual: English and Mandarin (grew up in California and Taiwan)
- Background: digital marketing and data science
- Technical skills: Python, SQL, Tableau, Power BI, GA4, Meta Ads, Google Ads
- Marketing: SEO, PPC, performance marketing, email marketing
- AI tools: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor, n8n
- Projects: dashboards, EDA, ML models, customer segmentation, fraud detection, marketing analytics

Job description summary:
${(item.json.description||'').substring(0,800)}

Requirements:
- Under 220 words
- Tone: confident, direct, human, not desperate
- Mention specifically how Jerry can help this company:
  * Reduce manual analysis time
  * Improve reporting speed
  * Connect marketing and data
  * Build AI-assisted workflows
  * Turn messy data into business action
- Do NOT start with 'I am writing to express'
- Reference the company by name`
  }
}));

parameters.subject: =🔥 Cover Letter Draft: {{ $('Build Cover Letter Prompt').item.json.job_title }} @ {{ $('Build Cover Letter Prompt').item.json.company }} (Score: {{ $('Build Cover Letter Prompt').item.json.score }})
parameters.message:
=

Cover Letter Draft

Role: {{ $('Build Cover Letter Prompt').item.json.job_title }}
Company: {{ $('Build Cover Letter Prompt').item.json.company }}
Score: {{ $('Build Cover Letter Prompt').item.json.score }}/100
Apply: {{ $('Build Cover Letter Prompt').item.json.job_url }}

{{ $json.choices[0].message.content }}
